messages.text:
The synthetic checks now match byte-for-byte for basic listing, long mode, tree mode, hidden files, classification, and the size/time sort paths.

I’m widening the comparison set to path edge cases and the real `rust-reference/tests/itest` fixture.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
checks=[
 ['probe_dir','-T','-L','0','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['probe_dir','-T','-L','1','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['probe_dir','-l','--sort','Ext','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['probe_dir','--group-directories-last','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['probe_dir','--only-dirs','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['probe_dir','--only-files','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['probe_dir/a.txt','probe_dir/sub','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['no_such_file','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['rust-reference/tests/itest','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['rust-reference/tests/itest','-T','-L','2','--color','never','--icons','never'],
 ['rust-reference/tests/itest','-l','--sort','name','--color','never','--icons','never'],
]
for args in checks:
    r=subprocess.run([ref]+args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    p=subprocess.run(['python','eza_py.py']+args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr)
    print(('OK   ' if ok else 'DIFF ')+ ' '.join(args))
    if not ok:
        print('codes',r.returncode,p.returncode)
        print('REFOUT',r.stdout[:300]); print('PYOUT ',p.stdout[:300])
        print('REFERR',r.stderr[:300]); print('PYERR ',p.stderr[:300])
'@ | python -"
